---
title: "`list_databases()` — enumerate gene-set collections"
---

## Purpose

Return a tibble of metadata for every registered gene-set collection — name,
species, license and citation — so you can pick the right database before
enrichment.

## When to use

Whenever you need the exact `name` token to pass to `ev_enrich()` or want to
confirm a collection's species and license before using it in a figure.

## How it works

Reads the bundled registry CSV (`inst/extdata/db_registry.csv`) and returns it
as a tibble, one row per collection. Each row carries `name`, `display_name`,
`type`, `species`, `source`, `license`, `citation_key`, and
`description_short`. If the registry is not installed the call aborts with a
clear error.

For provenance and licensing of a single collection, pass a `name` to
[`database_info`](database_info.qmd).

## Parameters & defaults

| Argument | Default | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| *(none)* | — | no arguments; returns the full registry tibble |

## Literature

No method-specific citation; see [methods](../methods.qmd). Per-database
citations live in the registry's `citation_key` column.

## Example

```r
db <- list_databases()
db[, c("name", "species", "license")]            # all registered collections
subset(db, species == "rat")$name                # rat-compatible sets
```
